movers.text: PG Boogie Fland (25 mpg) is ruled out vs. West Virginia with a right shoulder injury he re-aggravated vs. Notre Dame; he played through it vs. Houston (4 pts).
Freshman Tyran Stokes (23 mpg) has a right-leg bone bruise and missed West Virginia 11/18; Bill Self calls him day-to-day and a likely game-time decision vs. Houston.
Starter Neo Avdalas (24 mpg) is sidelined with a wrist injury (reported 11/17); UNC is adjusting its starting lineup.
G Braeden Carrington (28 mpg): imaging after a head collision 11/15 came back clear; Greg Gard said it looks like he'll play vs. Seton Hall. Jack Janicki starts if not.
F Coen Carr (22 mpg) has knee tendinitis per Tom Izzo; he may sit or play limited minutes vs. Detroit Mercy.
